description: This file is a shell script used for testing the git hook infrastructure, including various pre-receive, update, post-receive, and post-update hooks, as well as asserting their correct behavior during git operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, with a description of what is being tested.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the provided path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the given file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of a file to expected output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for use in the test inputs.
